title: Neon Pulse — Episode 3: Frequency Shift
description: Kael attempts to hack into the facility's mainframe to discover who is controlling his powers, only to find a signal that hits closer to home than he ever imagined.
character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves

scenes.narration: The static in my head isn't just noise. It's a map. I have to find the source of the broadcast before the lockdown seals me in for good.
scenes.visual: man running through a dark metallic corridor with sparks flying from wall conduits

scenes.narration: Amber light pulses along my sleeves, reacting to the heavy security doors ahead. Every flicker is a direct drain on my internal reserves.
scenes.visual: close up of glowing amber patterns on dark fabric surging with intense light

scenes.narration: I reach the terminal, and the console flares to life. Someone has been waiting for me to connect all along. They aren't just tracking me—they're logging my genetic signature.
scenes.visual: hands hovering over a holographic interface with complex blue data streams

scenes.narration: My pulse quickens as the screen displays a familiar symbol. It’s the emblem from the research facility where I was born. My past isn't a memory, it's an active experiment.
scenes.visual: staring at a glowing red icon on a monitor with eyes wide in shock

scenes.narration: The ventilation shafts hiss. Gas begins to flood the room, forcing me to make a choice. Stay and die with the truth, or break through the reinforced glass.
scenes.visual: thick vapor filling a small room with yellow emergency lights flashing

scenes.narration: I pour every watt of electricity into my palms. The glass screams under the pressure of the surge. One final push.
scenes.visual: clenched fists crackling with concentrated electricity aimed at a reflective surface

scenes.narration: The glass shatters, and I fall into the darkness of the lower sub-levels. The signal is stronger down here. And it’s calling my name.
scenes.visual: silhouette falling through shards of glass into a deep shadowy pit

scenes.narration: What else are they hiding in the deep? Follow along for more as the mystery of the pulse continues.
scenes.visual: looking up toward the light of the upper level from a dark abyss
